metadata.description: Safe, opinionated AI Google Ads operator for technical founders running their own Search ads

plugins.name: google-ads-copilot
plugins.description: 12 slash commands (bootstrap, daily, weekly, monthly, search-terms, budgets, creative, recommendations, explain, changes, undo, apply) backed by a senior-Google-Ads-operator agent and 10 skills (gaql, account-audit, conversion-health, smart-bidding, pmax, search-term-mining, budget-management, creative-management, change-execution, explain-to-beginner). Mutation safety is enforced by a deterministic shell script (bin/apply), not by the LLM: account-ID pin, schema validation, validate_only dry-run, append-only change-log, paired-proposal resource-name auto-substitution. The 'apply' command is the only one that mutates the account; everything else is read-only or writes a markdown proposal file you review first.
